chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abd al-Malik ibn Utbah al-Hashimi who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the elderly man and the elderly woman who are weak and unable to fast in the month of Ramadan. He said: 'She gives charity for each day with a mudd of wheat.'

key_terms.مُدٍّ: A mudd (a traditional unit of volume)

ai.seo_question: What is the fidyah for an elderly person who cannot fast in Ramadan?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the specific fidyah for the permanently elderly, mandating one mudd of wheat per missed day. This ruling distinguishes their obligation from that of the chronically ill, reflecting the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on precise measurement and the use of staple grains for expiation. It underscores the accessibility of religious duties for those with enduring physical limitations.
